caption: This image is a promotional poster split into two sections. On the left, a male soccer player in a light blue jersey, black shorts, black socks, and cleats is shown kicking in a large stadium filled with a crowd under bright lights. On the right, a blue panel features the Citi logo at the top and large white text reading “Celebrate the game with Coca-Cola.” Smaller text mentions fuel savings and gifts at Esso. A soccer ball graphic appears near the text. A boxed area shows a Coca-Cola pack for April and six contour glasses for May, with additional promotional details below. At the bottom are card images and the Coca-Cola, Cheers, FairPrice Xpress, and Esso logos.

The image shows the lower legs and feet of a person standing against a pale green and white gradient background. The person is wearing shiny red peep-toe high heels, with the feet close together and the toes visible through the openings. Around the lower calves is a large yellow paper crown with blue edging and multiple Burger King logos printed on it, including a large central logo and smaller ones near the top points. In the lower right corner, there is a bowl of salad containing green lettuce, sliced tomatoes, pale cheese pieces, and grilled chicken chunks. Nearby text reads “check our new chicken salads” in blue, green, orange, and red letters, with white decorative swirls beneath it.

This image is a Dunkin’ Donuts promotional infographic with a brown coffee-themed background. At the top left is the Dunkin’ Donuts logo, and near the top center an orange speech-bubble graphic reads “Flavor Radio!” with smaller text about a special radio advertisement releasing coffee aroma via sound recognition technology. A speaker icon, sound waves, and a white spray device appear across the top. The middle section shows a five-step illustrated sequence with buses, a speaker, coffee beans, people, a storefront, and a photo of a smiling woman holding a cup. A result panel shows “16%” and “29%.” At the bottom are a steaming coffee cup, coffee beans, several small photos, and blocks of explanatory text.

A red-orange promotional graphic shows a large bowl of salad on the right, filled with lettuce, grilled chicken pieces, corn, black beans, tortilla strips, cheese, and lime wedges. Behind the bowl is a large black decorative silhouette with curling shapes, plus small bird and pepper illustrations. On the left, yellow text reads “A Taste That Inspires,” followed by three checklist items in dark text: “New Trail,” “New Gear,” and “New Salad.” Near the lower left, a person is shown from behind running along a winding path across a stylized landscape. Faint background images include trail signs, a compass, and abstract food-like shapes. Yellow text at bottom right reads “The New Southwest Salad.”

The image shows three blue soda cans arranged against a solid blue background, with one can centered in the foreground and two slightly behind it on the left and right. Each can displays a circular red, white, and blue logo near the top and the word “pepsi” printed vertically in white. Large splashes of water curve around and behind the cans, with droplets scattered in the air. The cans stand on a glossy reflective surface that mirrors their lower portions and some of the water. Near the bottom center of the image, white text reads “REFRESH YOUR WORLD pepsi.” The overall composition is clean and symmetrical, with strong blue tones throughout.

The image is a mostly white advertisement-style graphic featuring a clear plastic bottle labeled “ethos WATER” entering from the upper left at a diagonal angle, with its open neck pointing toward the center-right. A stream of blue water pours from the bottle and forms a large heart shape filled with a watery texture and small bubbles. In the upper right corner, there is a small green circular Starbucks logo. At the bottom, large black text reads, “Your sip, their survival.” Below it is a smaller paragraph discussing clean water, the Ethos Water Fund, Starbucks, and a 5-cent contribution from each bottle purchase. No people are visible.

The image is a Coca-Cola advertisement on a white background. On the left, large text reads, “Share a Coke with a friend,” with the word “Coke” in red and the rest in black. Below it, smaller black text says, “Get in touch with a good friend, an old friend, or maybe even a new friend.” The website “shareacoke.com.au” appears underneath. On the right, two hands hold tilted Coca-Cola bottles that are touching near the tops, with soda splashing out of the openings. The red labels on the bottles display the names “Kylie” and “Luke” in large white letters. The Coca-Cola logo and the words “open happiness” appear in the upper right corner.

The image is a minimalist advertisement on a white background featuring two food items near the center: a red tomato with a green stem and a tall wedge-shaped piece of pale yellow cheese standing upright behind it. To the left of the foods, there is a block of small green text that reads, “Dunkin Donuts is now offering a little bit more than just your morning donut.We now offer personal pizzas made just for you whenever you want one.” Near the bottom center is the Dunkin’ Donuts logo with the slogan “more than coffee and donuts.” Along the very bottom edge, a line of fine print lists participating shop locations by state.

A promotional-style graphic shows a white background with faint vertical stripes and pale gray menu-item words scattered behind the main design. Centered near the top is a large yellow arch shape, partly covered by bold red and white text reading “THE HISTORICAL TIMELINE OF THE McDONALD’S MENU,” with smaller gray and yellow text below saying “IN THE USA.” Along the bottom is a row of food items: fried chicken pieces, a clear dessert cup with layered contents and a purple label, several sandwiches including a sesame-seed burger and a fish sandwich, a salad in a black bowl, a wrapped breakfast burrito, and two red cartons of French fries. No people are visible.

This image is a Burger King advertisement with a light beige background and large red text at the top reading, “COME BACK and SHAKE UP YOUR WAKE UP.” The Burger King logo appears in the upper right corner. In the center, there is a black bowl filled with a breakfast mixture that includes scrambled eggs, diced potatoes, and pieces of red and green vegetables. In front of the bowl on the right is a breakfast muffin sandwich with an English muffin, egg, cheese, and a sausage patty. Text on the left says “New BK Breakfast Bowl,” and text at the bottom right says “New BK Breakfast Muffin Sandwich.” Small fine print appears in the lower left corner.

The image shows a bright blue background with a large dark blue soda can positioned on the right side. The can is covered with visible water droplets and has a silver top and bottom edge. On the front is a circular red, white, and blue logo, and the word “pepsi” appears vertically in white lowercase letters. To the left of the can, large bold white text is arranged diagonally across the image, reading “REFRESH YOUR WORLD.” The text is tilted upward from left to right and occupies much of the left half of the composition. A faint shadow appears beneath the can, giving it a slightly floating look.

The image shows a white takeaway coffee cup placed on a wooden table in the lower left foreground. The cup has a white plastic lid, a circular green-and-black “STARBUCKS COFFEE” logo on the front, and a vertical row of small checkbox-style markings on the side. Near the bottom of the cup, small printed text is visible but not fully legible. The background is heavily blurred with warm golden and brown tones, suggesting an indoor setting with lights or furniture shapes. Large bold text appears across the right-center area reading, “The best coffee For the best YOU.” with “YOU.” in dark green. Below it, a white cursive line reads, “Taste of Inspiration.”

A bright red Coca-Cola advertisement fills the image. In the lower left and center, a smiling man and woman lean close together while each holds a glass Coca-Cola bottle. The man wears a gray shirt over a white undershirt and a wristwatch, and the woman has long wavy hair and wears a plaid shirt with red, blue, and white tones. White outlined circles resembling bubbles are scattered across the upper half of the poster. Large white text on the right reads “happiness. coca-cola.” Above it appears “#openhappiness.” The Coca-Cola logo is shown inside a red circular shape at the top right. A QR code and small white text appear in the bottom right corner.

A light blue background fills the image, with the white text “Filet-O-Fish®” centered near the top. In the middle is a transparent glass object shaped like a hamburger, made of two rounded bowl-like halves with a wavy glass layer between them. The object is filled with clear water and contains an orange fish visible through the glass, with its body in the upper section and part of its tail extending downward into the lower section. Small air bubbles appear in the water, and bright reflections and highlights emphasize the smooth glass surfaces. In the bottom right corner is a red square featuring the yellow McDonald’s arches and the yellow text “i’m lovin’ it.”

The image is a poster-style advertisement with a pale green background and a wide white border. Near the top left, large white text reads, “MAKES OTHER SNACKS LOOK SCARY.” In the center, two orange snack pieces are arranged to resemble spiders, with round bodies and multiple leg-like pieces extending outward. At the bottom right, there is a light-colored cup labeled “Dunkin’ Donuts Smoothie,” shown partly overlapping the white border and the green background. Along the bottom edge, a line of small black text is visible, including the words “Dunkin’ smoothies with real fruit, vitamin C, and low fat yogurt. AMERICA RUNS ON DUNKIN’.”

The image shows a single blue soda can centered against a dark blue background with a soft circular glow behind it. The can features the Pepsi logo near the top and the word “PEPSI” in large white letters across the middle. Its surface is decorated with abstract blue, white, and black graphic patterns. Clear water splashes and droplets surround the can, especially on the left and lower right sides, creating a sense of motion. A faint reflection and light pool appear beneath the can on the ground. Near the bottom center of the image, small white text reads, “every PEPSI refreshes the world.”

The image is a burger advertisement with a large hamburger centered against a dark red gradient background. The burger has a sesame seed bun, green leaf lettuce, thick red tomato slices, white onion rings, green pickle slices, strips of bacon, melted yellow cheese, and a grilled beef patty on the bottom bun. Large white text with a red outline at the top reads “BURRRRGERRR KING.” In the lower right area, smaller Portuguese text reads “AGORA COM SOTAQUE CARIOCA.” Additional small text appears beneath it. A Burger King logo is placed in the bottom right corner next to a small white silhouette of the Christ the Redeemer statue.

The image is a dark promotional-style graphic with a glowing cup of coffee on the left and large text on the right. The cup appears transparent or glass-like, with a handle and bright white and golden light shining from the top, creating a warm halo around it. Small glowing particles rise upward from the cup in a narrow vertical stream. On the right side, large bold white capital letters read “BUY ME A COFFEE.” In the lower left corner, there is a circular green-and-white Starbucks Coffee logo. Next to it, bold white text reads “STARBUCKS. REAL COFFEE.” No people are visible in the image.

The image is a bright red Coca-Cola advertisement featuring a smiling woman with long dark brown hair, shown from the chest up, holding a chilled Coca-Cola bottle toward the viewer. The bottle has a red label, visible condensation, and an open white cap area at the top. In the upper left corner is a red circular Coca-Cola logo. Large white text on the right reads “perfection,” with smaller white text below saying “perfección helada.” Yellow text near the bottle reads “ice cold.” A row of large ice cubes stretches across the bottom of the image. Small white watermark text appears in the lower left corner.

The image is a mostly white advertisement-style page with a single strip of bacon placed diagonally near the center, angled from upper left to lower right. To the lower left of the bacon is a block of small reddish text that reads, “Dunkin Donuts is now offering a little bit more than just your morning donut. We now have many breakfast sandwiches including this lovely slice of bacon if you chose it.” Near the bottom center is the Dunkin’ Donuts logo in orange and pink, followed by the phrase “more than coffee and donuts” in brown. Along the very bottom is a line of tiny gray text listing participating shop locations by state.

A poster-like image shows three firework shapes made from golden French fries against a smooth red background that darkens slightly toward the top. The largest burst appears on the left side, partly extending off the edge, while two smaller bursts are placed near the top center and upper right. Each burst is composed of many individual fries radiating outward like sparks. Near the lower center, white uppercase text reads, “CELEBRATING CANNES CREATIVE MARKETER OF THE YEAR.” At the bottom are a white cursive signature-style mark and a yellow “M” logo. No people are visible, and the overall design is clean and minimal.

A promotional poster shows a woman with long wavy brown hair wearing a bright blue sleeveless dress against a light blue background. She is holding a silver Diet Pepsi can near her mouth with one hand and has red nail polish and a pearl-like earring visible. A striped straw extends from the can. On the right side, Spanish text reads “prueba el gran sabor de diet pepsi” above a Pepsi logo and the words “Endulzado con Splenda Marca” inside an oval logo. Near the bottom, more text reads “más sexy que nunca” and “Únete al movimiento. pepsipr” with a Facebook icon. Another silver Diet Pepsi can appears at the lower right with a red lipstick kiss mark.

The image is a presentation-style layout with a large poster on the left and text with smaller photos on the right. The poster shows many coffee beans arranged in braille-like dot patterns on a white fabric surface hanging from a brown rod. Brown text on the poster reads “NOVOS CARDÁPIOS EM BRAILLE STARBUCKS.” and a green circular logo appears near the lower right corner. At the bottom left, small gray text reads “Copy: New Starbucks Braille Menus.” On the right, a heading says “COFFEE BRAILLE,” followed by sections titled “Challenge” and “Solution” with explanatory text. Three smaller photos below show close-up coffee beans, a person touching the display, and a man standing beside it.

The image shows a hamburger displayed against a black background on a round, rough wooden block covered partly with white paper. The burger has a black sesame-seed bun, green leaf lettuce, red tomato slices, white onion rings, pickles, melted yellow cheese, a beef patty, and visible sauce. To the right of the burger is large white text reading “HALLOWEEN WHOPPER,” with smaller text below that says “A1 FLAVOR BAKED INTO THE BUN,” where “A1” appears in red. In the lower right area, a bottle labeled “A1” lies on its side, with dark sauce visible at the bottle opening and a small spill nearby.

A wide advertisement-style image shows four glass soda bottles standing side by side against a solid dark red background. From left to right, the labels are red, green, black, and silver, each with white or contrasting script text, and the bottles are filled with dark liquid and covered with visible condensation droplets. Large white text on the right reads, “Good things come in fours.” Near the lower right, smaller white text says, “choose happiness,” beside a small graphic of four bottle silhouettes in matching colors. Fine vertical white text appears along the lower left edge, and there are no visible people in the image.

The image shows a minimalist advertisement-style composition on a solid red background. Near the center, four curved French fries are arranged in descending size to resemble a Wi‑Fi signal icon, with the largest arc at the top and the smallest at the bottom. The fries are golden yellow and cast subtle shadows, giving them a slightly raised appearance against the flat background. There are no people visible. In the lower right corner, a yellow “M” logo appears above the words “love free wi-fi,” with “love” in yellow and “free wi-fi” in white. The overall layout is clean, sparse, and strongly graphic.

The image is a poster with a pale yellow background and large colorful text at the top reading, “YOU CAN’T PUT A PRICE ON HAPPINESS.” In the center is a large coin shown upright, partly covered and overlapped by a chocolate-frosted donut with multicolored sprinkles. The donut has a bite-shaped missing section near the top center, exposing the coin behind it. Visible text on the coin includes “UNITED STATES OF AM” and “LIBERTY.” Near the bottom, bold orange-and-white text says, “BUT 25 CENT DONUTS HELP.” Smaller text below mentions “October 25th” and “25 cent donuts.” In the lower right corner are small logos and the words “AMERICA RUNS ON DUNKIN’.”

The image is a beverage advertisement featuring a large paper cup filled with a dark iced drink. The cup stands on the left side and has a red, white, and blue design with water droplets covering its surface. Ice cubes and bubbles are visible at the top of the drink. The background is divided into bright red at the upper left and blue at the lower right, separated by a large white curved shape with splash-like edges and scattered droplets. On the right side, large white text reads “ENJOY A PEPSI.” At the bottom right, smaller white text reads “LIVE FOR NOW,” with a circular red, white, and blue logo inside the word “NOW.”

A promotional-style image is divided into four sections around a large circular logo in the center. Each section shows a clear glass mug filled with a different hot drink topped with whipped cream or foam. The top left drink has whipped cream with caramel drizzle, and the top right drink has whipped cream covered with small chocolate pieces. The bottom left drink has a smooth foam top with a caramel lattice pattern, while the bottom right drink has whipped cream dusted with a brown powder. A dark green banner across the middle reads “STARBUCKS SEASONAL BLENDS” at the top, with white text on either side of the logo saying, “The perfect blend for your favorite show...” and “...and any other occasion.”

A tall stack of four cartoon-style cows stands near the center-left of a pale gray background. The cows are white with black patches, peach-colored snouts and hooves, and exaggerated facial features. The bottom cow kneels on one leg with a strained expression, supporting two cows above it, while a fourth cow balances at the top with one arm raised. Two of the middle cows wear red neckerchiefs, and one appears to have a small hat. Their tails and legs stick out in different directions, emphasizing the unstable tower. A soft shadow and faint reflection appear beneath them. In the lower right corner, a round Burger King logo and the text “BK™ STACKER” are visible.

The image shows a digital UNO game displayed on a wooden tabletop background made of dark horizontal planks.
